profile.name: Soumyadip Ghara
profile.subtitle: BCA Undergrad & Developer
profile.heroDescription: Engineering interactive 3D web experiences, defensive cybersecurity intelligence platforms, and embedded hardware security prototypes — from microchip to pixel.
aboutParagraphs: I am Soumyadip Ghara, an undergraduate student pursuing a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) with a deep passion for interactive 3D web graphics, defensive cybersecurity, and microcontroller prototyping.

Whether I'm rendering real-time WebGL scenes with Three.js, writing foundational algorithms in C, or designing hardware-level USB security firewalls on ESP32 and Arduino boards, I focus on building systems that are fast, resilient, and visually striking.
profile.baseLocation: Malighati, Paschim Medinipur, West Bengal, India

timeline.title: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)
timeline.description: Undergraduate study focused on computer science fundamentals, C programming, data structures, algorithmic problem-solving, and modern web architecture. I use these foundations to turn ideas into practical software and interactive experiences.

timeline.title: Smart India Hackathon (SIH) Innovator
timeline.description: Worked with Team Crimson Eclipse on CyberTrace AI (SIH26106), a forensic-intelligence platform concept for suspicious-email analysis. Its focus includes examining email headers, identifying phishing and threat indicators, tracing sender IP geolocation, and organizing findings for investigation.

timeline.title: Interactive 3D Web Experiences
timeline.description: Build immersive web experiences with Three.js and WebGL, combining real-time 3D scenes, animated interface details, and scroll-driven storytelling. My portfolio's space environment brings together a galaxy, stars, planets, a satellite, and a time-travel-inspired camera journey.

timeline.title: Cybersecurity & Hardware Prototyping
timeline.description: Explore defensive security through email-threat forensics, scam and phishing analysis, and USB hardware-firewall concepts. Prototype embedded ideas with C, ESP32, and Arduino, including the AI-Shield concept for identifying unauthorized USB HID and BadUSB activity.

projects.title: CyberTrace AI
projects.description: AI-Powered Email Threat Detection, GeoLocation tracking, and Forensic Intelligence Platform built with Team Crimson Eclipse.

projects.title: AI-Shield USB Firewall
projects.description: OS-independent hardware security microchip architecture designed to intercept and block physical USB HID/BadUSB threats in real time.

projects.title: SG Word
projects.description: A word-processing app and your own alternative to Microsoft Word, designed for working with written documents.

projects.title: Cataloge Craft
projects.description: An AI-powered website concept for creating polished product catalogs from product details and creative prompts.
